'The Queen of the Palace' will return to the place where she wrote history in 2020, after she confirmed her spot in the top five of the Women's Series. Sherrock became the first (and only) woman to pick up wins at Alexandra Palace, beating Ted Evetts and Mensur Suljovic before losing to Chris Dobey. messages.text: Man Utd fans take aim at Man City with return of famous ticker banner

metadata.summary: Manchester United's famous ticker banner returned to Old Trafford on Saturday, displaying 50 years since Manchester City won a trophy.
metadata.content: Man City charges: Manchester United fans take aim at rivals with return of famous ticker banner | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Man City charges: Manchester United fans take aim at rivals with return of famous ticker banner Man Utd fans' famous banner mocking the years since Man City won a trophy returned to Old Trafford on Saturday; United were playing first game since City were found guilty of all serious breaches of Premier League financial rules by an independent commission Saturday 10 October 2026 19:08, UK Image: The banner displays 50 years - ticking over to 51 years - since Man City won the 1976 League Cup Manchester United's famous ticker banner returned to Old Trafford on Saturday, displaying 50 years since Manchester City won a trophy. The banner was first displayed in 2000, at which point it was 24 years since City last won a trophy - the 1976 League Cup. The year listed on the banner ticked over every year until 2011, when City ended their trophy drought by beating Stoke in the FA Cup final - their first silverware since Sheikh Mansour's takeover.
